translation.question: 2025年のルーマニア大統領選挙で次点となったのは誰ですか？
translation.translation_note: Translated 'runner-up' as '次点' (jiten) which is standard for elections. Used the standard Japanese transliteration for the Romanian name George (ゲオルゲ).

backtranslation_en.question: Who was the runner-up in the 2025 Romanian presidential election?
